correctness.rationale: For arbitrary a>0, alpha>0 and positive integer m,k, conditioning gives exact block survival R=alpha t^-alpha int_0^t u^(alpha-1) erf(a/(2 sqrt u))^k du. The true long-time error-function asymptotic yields three regimes with critical logarithms and positive constants. The layer-cake identity gives necessary and sufficient all-q moment integrability; strict probability-space Lp norm monotonicity yields group-size ordering at fixed N. Boundary alpha=k/2, q equal to the exponent, and integer partitions are explicitly addressed. The standalone checker passed 54 diagnostics; finite numerics are not used as infinite proof.

value.rationale: The precise critical moment threshold isolates independent environment replication from raw particle redundancy: for N=6 and alpha=2/5, changing block size from 2 to 3 changes finite versus infinite mean first-arrival time while keeping identical one-particle marginals. Full tail constants and logarithmic boundary make a natural physics question quantitative. This is a motivated complete all-parameter classification, not an arbitrary numerical slice.
